name: filter_matrix
comment: filter() per-column on a matrix (2026-05-30). MATLAB filter(b,a,X) operates along the first non-singleton dimension and RESETS the delay state between signals; numkit previously filtered the whole column-major buffer as ONE signal, leaking state across the column boundary (Y(1,2) came out 7 instead of 2). FIR [1 1] on [1 2;3 4;5 6]: col1 [1;3;5]->[1;4;8], col2 [2;4;6]->[2;6;10] so a11=1, a12=2, a32=10. IIR a=[1 -0.5]: col1 [1;3;5]->[1;3.5;6.75] so i31=6.75. [Y,zf] gives zf as (nfilt-1)xncols, one final state per column: zf=[2.5 3] (z1=2.5, z2=3). 3-D arrays filter along dim-1 too. The optional DIM 5th arg (filter(b,a,X,zi,dim)) is not yet supported -- deferred. namespace=signal. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
